blockers.desc: CoreX SDK ships no nvcc (red line: no nvcc); lc0 meson.build drives .cu compilation through an nvcc-style program.
blockers.error: no nvcc on PATH; CUDA frontend on CoreX is clang++ -x ivcore --cuda-gpu-arch=ivcore11
blockers.root_cause: 结论: CUDA + cuDNN backends build with clang++ (ivcore11); .cu -> .o via wrapper.

attempts.action: Add corex_nvcc_wrapper.sh that answers meson probes (-h/--dryrun) and translates nvcc flags to clang++ -x ivcore, dropping -arch/-gencode/-code/-Xcompiler/-Wno-deprecated-gpu-targets; gate it behind a new -Dcorex meson option.

blockers.desc: fp16 kernels gated behind '#if __CUDA_ARCH__ >= 530'; on ivcore11 device __CUDA_ARCH__ reports 300, so real fp16 kernel bodies would be silently compiled out (SKIP_FP16_BITS empty-kernel fallback) -> silent-wrong runtime, not a compile error.
blockers.root_cause: 结论: fp16 kernels compile with real bodies on ivcore11; fp16_kernels.cu builds clean, cuda-fp16 / cudnn-fp16 backends register.

attempts.action: Bypass the NV arch gate via __ILUVATAR__ (compat-index case: 'NV 530/700 numeric gate silently cuts fp16 paths'): '#if defined(__ILUVATAR__) || (__CUDA_ARCH__ >= 530)' and '#if !defined(__ILUVATAR__) && (__CUDA_ARCH__ < 530)'.

blockers.desc: CUTLASS backend (cutlass_kernels.cu) targets cutlass::arch::Sm80 (Ampere+); ivcore11 (BI-V150) is not Ampere and CoreX reports max_cuda arch 0.
blockers.root_cause: 结论: CUTLASS is an optional Ampere-only acceleration path; excluded as out-of-scope for ivcore11. Not a terminal blocker for the CUDA backend.

attempts.action: Disable optional CUTLASS backend (-Dcutlass=false); meson also auto-gates it on max_cuda>=800 which is unmet. Core CUDA (plain_cuda) + cuDNN backends fully cover lc0 GPU inference without CUTLASS.
